Rollback cannot prove freshness"},{"id":"host.handle","label":"Opaque original range handle
No autonomous socket or retry"},{"id":"journal","label":"RUST JOURNAL / SEPARATE FATE"},{"id":"journal.commit","label":"Canonical operation and lineage

Lost reply does not mint authority"},{"id":"journal.recovery","label":"Authenticated complete recovery

Original claim / current range binding

Accepted copies can drain after cut

Controls business application"},{"id":"quint","label":"QUINT
